description: This is an HTML file implementing the front-end UI for a database viewer application. It includes embedded CSS styles for layout and styling, as well as JavaScript code to interact with backend API endpoints to load database lists, tables, and table data dynamically. The script handles user interactions such as refreshing database lists, selecting databases/tables, and viewing table data with expandable cells.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list manually, resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and loads tables from API.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a specific database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data array and inserts into container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls, as well as expandable cells.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
